name: semantic-implementation-diff
intent: Trace contracts, state transitions, outputs, errors, and effects across implementations and expose the smallest meaningful semantic divergence.
successCondition: Stop when every observed semantic difference is classified and minimized, and every unobserved region is explicit.
inputs: two bounded implementations and their contracts
observable state output error and effect model
outputs: equivalence fixtures divergences and unobserved limits
operations: trace outputs errors state transitions and effects
classify equivalent divergent and unobserved regions
minimize each divergence into a regression fixture
preconditions: both implementations can run in a bounded comparable harness
positiveTriggers: Compare two implementations for contract-level semantic differences.
Verify a rewrite or migration against observable behavior and effects.
negativeTriggers: Declare arbitrary programs equivalent from matching source shape.
Ignore environment or dependency differences that affect behavior.
failureModes: stop when environments cannot be normalized
label unobserved behavior instead of inferring equivalence
exclusions: does not prove undecidable general equivalence
does not execute untrusted code without a sandbox
terminationConditions: Stop when every observed semantic difference is classified and minimized, and every unobserved region is explicit.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-daedalus route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
